extent.definition: Complete coverage of the reviewed node contract at the declared 26.5N full-basin-width Atlantic section; this does not imply direct observation at every latitude.

transformations.formula: Average only finite RAPID moc_mar_hc10 half-daily values; require at least 80 percent of expected twice-daily observations for a calendar month and never impute missing values.
Subtract monthly mean AMOC transport from RAPID’s documented 16.9 Sv long-term mean so larger shortfall maps upward.
Map monthly transport through prior-month median / p25 / p10 / p2.5 anchors expressed in worsening order because lower transport is worse.
Subtract the latest complete monthly mean from the preceding complete monthly mean and normalize the decline through prior complete monthly changes.
Assign full extent only for the full-basin-width 26.5N section declared in the reviewed AMOC metric contract.

receipts.uncertainty: Sparse sampling, platform changes, mapping, depth selection, seasonal aliasing, and model-data blending affect the estimate. Sub-annual variability is large, and a low monthly value is not evidence of collapse or a persistent secular decline.
receipts.freshness: Latest authoritative RAPID release published 2026-01-27, with the latest coverage-qualified observation month 2024-02; snapshot captured 2026-07-31T20:30:17.460Z. The mooring-recovery and quality-control lag is explicit internal metadata.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: RAPID supplies 239 coverage-qualified monthly observations of full-basin-width AMOC transport at the contract’s declared 26.5N section, directly supporting current magnitude, historical position, monthly momentum and node-domain extent.
